rationale: After NEWAPP-003 identifies the actual shared NEWERP keys, reconcile the proposed NEWAPP DDL and repository mappings against those real types without changing the shared database. This is a design/test-artifact task only; any actual schema application remains separately gated.
validation_focus: Do not execute DDL or DML against the shared NEWERP database.
Map neutral CustomerKey, SupplierKey, UserKey and TenantId references to the actual types documented by NEWAPP-003.
Prefer direct FK/view/repository mapping to existing NEWERP master data; never create duplicate Customer/Supplier master tables.
Produce a reviewable migration plan, rollback notes and disposable/test-database validation where available.
Any operation that would alter shared database structure must stop at the Human Gate and must not be executed by this task.
risks: The task is dependency-blocked until NEWAPP-003 is completed and its schema map is accepted.
No destructive migration, DROP/TRUNCATE, production DML, or production deployment is allowed.
Do not guess missing key types; preserve unresolved mappings explicitly.
